_comment: Attach to the ECS TASK role (taskRoleArn in ecs/task-definition.json) AND the Batch job role (jobRoleArn in batch/job-definition.json) -- same permissions either way, since it's the same Python code running via boto3 whether it's launched as a single ECS task (01/07/08/09/Assemble) or a Batch array job shard (02-06). Deliberately narrow: only the three AWS services horror-corpus-validation's scripts actually call (Bedrock Converse in 04, Comprehend in 05, Translate in 06), plus the EFS access the shared data/ mount needs. No S3, no EC2, no IAM, nothing account-wide -- see docs/COST_SAFETY.md for why that separation matters on this project specifically.

Statement._comment: Comprehend's detect-dominant-language API doesn't support resource-level restriction -- Resource must be *. Scoped down to a single read-only API action instead.
Same as Comprehend above -- Translate has no resource-level ARNs, scoped to a single action instead.
